pipeline.session.BlockAwareOSCSender#

class pipeline.session.BlockAwareOSCSender(osc_sender, scheduler: BlockScheduler)[source]#

Bases: object

Wraps an OSCSender and silences it during rest blocks.

All send* calls are forwarded to the underlying osc_sender only while scheduler.is_nf_active is True. Calls during rest phases are silently discarded.

Parameters:

  • osc_sender – An ANT OSCSender instance (or compatible object).

  • scheduler – The active BlockScheduler whose is_nf_active property gates all outgoing OSC messages.
